theme_and_identity.theme: Light theme primary (white marble focus) with deep navy and forest green contrast sections.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' Pairing. Elegant Serif for headings to convey luxury, clean Geometric/Humanist Sans for body to ensure legibility.

scale_rules.H1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[6rem] tracking-tighter leading-none font-medium

typography.instructions: Never use Inter for headings. Keep serif headings highly contrasting in weight. Headings must use tight tracking, overlines must use extremely wide tracking.

rules.gradients: Do not use generic tech gradients. Only use subtle radial gradients to mimic spotlighting on products, or a gentle gold sheen.
rules.contrast: Ensure pure navy (#0A1128) is used against pure white or marble for maximum striking contrast. No muddy grays.
rules.accents: Gold (#D4AF37) should be used sparingly for thin borders, active states, and ornate botanical/divider elements.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Optical Clarity' Glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/40 shadow-sm) for sticky nav and product detail modals. Solid backgrounds for main sections.
visual_enhancers.borders: Ornate but minimal. 1px solid gold (#D4AF37) borders for premium cards or divider lines. Clipped frame edges for photography (e.g., subtle rounded corners mixed with sharp corners).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffused ambient shadows (shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(10,17,40,0.08)]) for floating elements. Avoid harsh dropshadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: White marble background pattern should subtly overlay the hero and footer sections. Green botanical leaves used as absolute positioned overlapping elements for depth.

spacing_and_layout.container: Max-width 8xl, centered. But break out of container for full-bleed images and marquees.
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Extremely generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. gap-8 to gap-16 in grids.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. Asymmetrical grids for features. Standard 3-column for products.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense text. Center-align hero statements if tightly grouped. Use optical alignment for icons.

motion_and_interaction.smooth_scroll: MANDATORY: Implement `lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling across the marketing pages.
motion_and_interaction.hero_reveal: MANDATORY: Kinetic Hero with masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion (overflow-hidden wrapper, text translates Y from 100% to 0%).
motion_and_interaction.scroll_animations: Framer Motion `whileInView` for section scroll reveals. Fade up + slight Y translation (e.g., y: 40 -> 0). Stagger children in grids.
motion_and_interaction.parallax: Subtle parallax on botanical leaf accents and marble background using framer-motion `useScroll` and `useTransform`.
motion_and_interaction.micro_interactions: Image scales up 1.05x on card hover. Gold border reveals or expands on hover. Buttons have a liquid or sweep fill effect.
motion_and_interaction.marquee: One slow editorial marquee (react-fast-marquee). High contrast, serif font, uppercase, separated by gold dot or leaf icon. Very slow speed.

components.marketing_hybrid_rule: Marketing layouts MUST use pure HTML/Tailwind and framer-motion. Do NOT use Shadcn Card or Section. Build custom, asymmetrical, overlapping structures.
components.admin_dashboard: Use strict Shadcn components. Dense, functional, 'Soft Utility' approach. Separate layout from marketing.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular with 1px gold border. Hover state should inverse colors or slide in a background color.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog but heavily style it to match luxury branding (glassmorphism overlay, serif headings, gold accents).

section_by_section_direction.Header: Sticky fixed header, z-50. Glassmorphism background. Logo (Water droplet + leaves). Nav links with subtle gold hover underline. CTA 'Contact Us' button.
section_by_section_direction.Hero: Full viewport height (min-h-screen). Background: white marble texture. Subtle parallax 3D water drop or high-res droplet image. Large text: 'LUXURY HOME CARE COLLECTION' (masked reveal). Subheading: 'Premium Cleaning Solutions Crafted for Modern Living'. Three pillar badges absolutely positioned. CTA 'Explore Collection'.
section_by_section_direction.Editorial_Marquee: Slow moving text: 'SPOTLESS AND PURE • PREMIUM QUALITY YOU CAN TRUST • CRAFTED FOR MODERN LIVING • '
section_by_section_direction.Product_Showcase: Section title with gold ornate divider. 3-column grid. Cards: Spotlight product photography, clipped frame borders. Hover: Image slight zoom, 'View Details' button appears. Click opens styled Modal with rich details.
section_by_section_direction.Key_Features: Value Grid (Bento style). Asymmetrical boxes highlighting: Effective Cleaning, Long Lasting Fragrance, Sparkling Shine, Safe For Everyday Use, Homes & Professionals. Mix dark navy cards with gold text, and white cards with dark green text.
section_by_section_direction.About_Manifesto: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03) flowing vertically. Large serif typography. Botanical leaf accents overlapping the edges.
section_by_section_direction.Sustainability: Make in India ethos. Dark Forest Green background. Large Lion Emblem (faded in bg or crisp beside text). Focus on environmental safety and premium sourcing.
section_by_section_direction.Contact: Split layout. Left: Address, map/image, gold accents. Right: Custom styled Shadcn Form. Floating labels or clean underline inputs.
section_by_section_direction.Footer: Massive padding (py-32). Dark Navy background. Make in India badge. Quality strip. Large 'Elvora-X' watermark text. Quick links.
section_by_section_direction.Admin_Panel: Route `/admin`. Protected (mock auth). Simple table (Shadcn Table) listing contact enquiries. Pure functional styling, no marble or gold needed.

marble_texture.description: White marble texture for Hero and background overlays.

botanical_leaves.description: Green leaves for parallax accents and overlapping decor.

water_drop_macro.description: Macro water droplet for Hero visual or section transition.

product_light_green.description: Forest Blossom - Premium Floor Cleaner (Green bottle placeholder).

product_yellow.description: Forest Dew - Premium Dish Wash (Yellow bottle placeholder).

product_dark_green.description: Royal Forest - Premium Phenyl (Dark green bottle placeholder).

lion_emblem.description: Marble Lion statue for Sustainability / Make in India section.

luxury_interior.description: Luxury living room to use as faint background for 'Homes & Professional Spaces' feature.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis, react-fast-marquee, lucide-react.
Add fonts `Cormorant Garamond` and `Manrope` from Google Fonts in index.html or global css.
Do NOT use standard card components for the marketing page; use raw divs with Tailwind for asymmetrical awwwards-level layouts.
Implement masked line-by-line text reveal in the Hero section. Wrap text lines in overflow-hidden divs and animate the inner text sliding up.
Ensure Lenis is wrapped around the main app or marketing routes to provide the required momentum scrolling.
Keep the Admin Panel (Shadcn based) visually distinct and simple. Focus Awwwards-level creativity purely on the public marketing landing page.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) as per testing requirements.
Never use `transition: all`. Specify properties, e.g., `transition-transform duration-500 ease-out`.
Always use the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
